question: A 58-year-old lifeguard develops squamous cell carcinoma of the skin on his forehead. Which of the following most likely preceded the development of this carcinoma?
analysis: Squamous cell carcinoma of the skin is most commonly associated with chronic sun exposure, particularly to UVC radiation. The lifeguard's occupation likely involved prolonged sun exposure, which is a major risk factor for the development of squamous cell carcinoma.
